name: Ānāpānasati step 1: long breath (dīghaṁ assasāmī)
method_summary: Breathing in long he knows 'I breathe in long'; breathing out long he knows 'I breathe out long' (knowing, pajānāti). Step 1 of the sixteen, in tetrad 1, which the sutta identifies with the contemplation of body (mn118:24). The sutta numbers no steps; they are counted from the four tetrads.

name: Mindfulness of breathing (ānāpānassati)
method_summary: Place and posture: gone to the forest, the root of a tree or an empty hut, the monk sits with legs crossed, body upright, mindfulness established in front, and mindfully breathes in and mindfully breathes out (mn118:17). Then sixteen steps in four tetrads: (1) knowing a long breath, (2) a short breath, (3) training in experiencing the whole body, (4) calming the bodily formation; (5) experiencing rapture, (6) pleasure, (7) the mental formation, (8) calming the mental formation; (9) experiencing the mind, (10) gladdening the mind, (11) concentrating the mind, (12) liberating the mind; (13) contemplating impermanence, (14) fading away, (15) cessation, (16) relinquishment (mn118:18-21). The sutta identifies the tetrads with contemplation of the body, feelings, mind and dhammas (mn118:24-27). Stated fruit: great fruit and benefit; it fulfils the four establishments, which fulfil the seven awakening factors, which fulfil knowledge and liberation (mn118:15).
prerequisites: The text's own condition: 'Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa ānāpānassatiṁ vadāmi' - it does not speak of mindfulness of breathing for one of muddled mindfulness and without clear comprehension (mn118:26). Place and posture as at mn118:17.
signs_of_progress: The text states no bodily or mental signs of its own beyond the arising of the awakening factors in sequence (mn118:30-36).

name: The four establishments of mindfulness (satipaṭṭhāna)
method_summary: In MN 118 the four establishments are fulfilled by mindfulness of breathing and, developed, fulfil the seven awakening factors (mn118:23-40). Monks devoted to their development are named at mn118:13.
